hints.title: Digit Position Constraints
hints.text: A 3-digit even number must have hundreds digit between 1 and 9 and units digit in {0, 2, 4, 6, 8}.

hints.title: Distinct Indices Enumeration
hints.text: Pick distinct indices i, j, k from the input array to construct the candidate number digits[i] * 100 + digits[j] * 10 + digits[k].

hints.title: Uniqueness Set
hints.text: Insert each formed integer into a hash set to deduplicate identical numbers and return the size.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Triple nested loops iterate over distinct index triplets, bounded by at most 450 unique 3-digit even numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: n is small, so cubic iteration runs within microseconds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set stores at most 450 integers for O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce no-leading-zero and even parity constraints using set deduplication.
